title: Properly handle `fs` and `io-std` under emscripten
author: Darksonn
body_preview: The emscripten target may currently block the thread when `tokio::fs` or `tokio::io::stdin` is used on emscripten if threads are not supported.  This should be resolved, probably either by using a different set of native emscripten APIs that are async, or by restricting these APIs to emscripten with pthreads.

title: `tokio::io::unix` should not be feature-gated on `net`
author: dfoxfranke
body_preview: **Version** 1.53.1  **Description** The entire `tokio::io::unix` module is feature-gated on `net`. This seems inappropriate, since it just provides general facilities for checking file descriptor readiness. Nothing in it, except for some documentation examples, is at all specific to sockets.
